attributes.input.value: Under Article 71 of the AI Act proposal, what is the maximum administrative fine for non-compliance with the prohibited AI practices in Article 5?
attributes.output.value: The maximum administrative fine for non-compliance with the prohibited AI practices in Article 5 (subliminal techniques and exploiting vulnerabilities) is up to 30,000,000 EUR or 6% of the offender's total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.
